description:
We are searching for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate the systems behind Amazon's talent evaluation process, which managers, HRBPs, and leaders use to evaluate hundreds of thousands of employees in every talent cycle. In this role, you will own features end to end, from design through production. You will make sound technical trade-offs and deliver solutions that are reliable, secure, and easy to maintain. If you are a collaborative, curious engineer who enjoys ambiguous problems and high-visibility launches, we want to hear from you.

The Talent Evaluation team within Amazon's Talent Solutions organization owns the employee rating systems of Amazon's talent cycle. That includes the services that store and serve evaluation data and the manager and HRBP experiences in A to Z. We are using GenAI to simplify these experiences, for example AI-generated contribution summaries that help managers prepare, and AI-native integrations that bring talent data into the tools people already use. We build these systems with Amazon's highest bar on data privacy, accuracy, and compliance, because every rating and decision affects someone's career.

On our team, you will learn the internal systems and processes behind Amazon's performance culture. You will work directly with product, science, HR, and legal partners, who are a meeting invite or Slack message away, so ideas move to shipped solutions quickly.

We are a team of tenured Amazonians who care about getting the details right for the people who rely on our systems. We build on the latest AWS technologies, operate our own services, and move with a startup approach to building and iterating.

We are looking for engineers who operate with a high degree of ownership and customer obsession, and who collaborate well with partner teams to meet VP and S-team objectives.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, and deploy features and services end to end, from technical design through production, with little guidance.
- Build reliable, scalable, and secure systems that handle peak talent-cycle traffic and sensitive employee data, and make sound trade-offs between delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code, and raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and fully automated CI/CD pipelines.
- Own the operational health of your services, including monitoring, alarms, on-call, and root-cause analysis, and drive improvements that prevent repeat issues.
- Work with product, UX, science, and partner engineering teams to clarify ambiguous requirements, and identify where generative AI and agentic - tools can improve customer experiences and team productivity.
- Mentor junior engineers and interns, and contribute to a culture of learning and engineering excellence

About the team
The Talent Evaluation team owns the systems that record and protect how Amazon evaluates its people. We build and run the rating and evaluation platform behind Amazon's talent cycle. That covers the services that store and serve every employee's evaluation data, the A to Z experiences where managers enter and calibrate ratings, the tools HRBPs use to correct, override, and audit them, and AI-generated contribution summaries that help managers prepare. Downstream, our data feeds compensation, promotion, rehire eligibility, and people analytics across the company.

Our customers are the whole company. Every talent cycle, managers, HRBPs, and leaders from the smallest orgs up to S-team use our systems to evaluate hundreds of thousands of employees. When the cycle opens, our systems are among the most visible at Amazon, and the work has to be accurate, secure, and available on day one.

You will own real production software. The team owns several production pipelines across backend services, data pipelines, and front-end applications on AWS. Engineers own their services end to end, from design and code to deployment, alarms, and on-call. We are in the process of moving our pipelines to full CI/CD with no manual steps.

We value clear communication, an inclusive environment where every voice counts. If you want work that affects every Amazonian, with real ownership, an AI-first engineering culture, and a team that invests in your growth, we'd love to hear from you.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . 


USA, WA, Seattle - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually
